suppressions.rationale: The application wires TabBar, TokenSearchField, NavStack and the app-owned search/overflow helpers inside modules the entry imports (startHotSheetWebClient and its interaction groups, retained in one teardown); Kerf ui-wiring credits only calls written in the entry file and cannot resolve app-owned helpers (KF-KWMJMS, HS2-Y2QG3G). Remove when that ships.

wireCatalog already installs wireScrollDividers on the demo root (a second instance loops forever, HS2-E6AG7W, KF-XKMC7W), and the demo calls the app-owned wireTicketSearchFields/wireWorkspaceOverflowKeyboard helpers that Kerf cannot resolve yet (KF-KWMJMS). Remove when both ship.
